prs.author: raashish1601

(2 PRs)

prs.cluster_pick_reason: 2215 fixes a real behavioral bug (shouldAttemptFallback's root check was comparing against '/' when the stripped pathname is actually '', so the redundant-fallback-request short-circuit never engaged) rather than only a cosmetic edge case. members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both rewrite the exact same trailing-slash-stripping block in buildWellKnownPath() (packages/client/src/client/auth.ts), which will produce a merge conflict on identical lines. #2214 generalizes the single-trailing-slash strip (`pathname.endsWith('/') ? slice(0,-1) : pathname`) to a regex that strips multiple trailing slashes, and applies the same generalization in buildDiscoveryUrls(). #2215 introduces a normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper that performs the identical `replace(/\/+$/, '')` strip (so it already subsumes #2214's core fix for buildWellKnownPath) and additionally corrects shouldAttemptFallback(), which still compared the normalized pathname against '/' even though stripping now yields '' for a root path — meaning the 'already at root, skip fallback' short-circuit never fired and a redundant fallback discovery request was always attempted for root-like paths. (2 PRs)

members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both rewrite the exact same trailing-slash-stripping block in buildWellKnownPath() (packages/client/src/client/auth.ts), which will produce a merge conflict on identical lines. #2214 generalizes the single-trailing-slash strip (`pathname.endsWith('/') ? slice(0,-1) : pathname`) to a regex that strips multiple trailing slashes, and applies the same generalization in buildDiscoveryUrls(). #2215 introduces a normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper that performs the identical `replace(/\/+$/, '')` strip (so it already subsumes #2214's core fix for buildWellKnownPath) and additionally corrects shouldAttemptFallback(), which still compared the normalized pathname against '/' even though stripping now yields '' for a root path — meaning the 'already at root, skip fallback' short-circuit never fired and a redundant fallback discovery request was always attempted for root-like paths. (2 PRs)
